## OPS.DNC-LIFT · Slack Approval (Consent Model v1, 2026-09-28)

**Review card** — LP MCP `request_dnc_lift_review` POSTs a contact summary to the *DNC Lift Review* webhook (header `X-DNC-Lift-Secret` must equal `$env.DNC_LIFT_WEBHOOK_SECRET`). The card goes to **#dnc-lift-approval** with ✅ Approve Lift · ⛔ Keep Blocked.

**Click** — Slack posts every click to LP MCP `/webhook/slack/interactions` (signature checked there). `dnc_lift_*` clicks are relayed ONLY to the *DNC Lift Click* webhook here (LP MCP env `SLACK_DNC_LIFT_FORWARD_URL`), never to OPS.SLK-E. The relay must carry `X-LPMCP-Forward-Auth` = `$env.SLACK_INTERACTIONS_FORWARD_AUTH`; without it the click is refused.

The click POSTs to LP MCP `/slack/dnc-lift/decision`, replaces the card (buttons gone, who + when), and replies in the thread with GHL / LP / Five9 results. Any failure @-mentions Mark.

n8n env: DNC_LIFT_WEBHOOK_SECRET, SLACK_INTERACTIONS_FORWARD_AUTH, optional SLACK_DNC_LIFT_CHANNEL_ID, DNC_LIFT_ESCALATE_SLACK_ID (default Mark).

Built INACTIVE. Mark runs one end-to-end test on a test contact before activating.
